text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Too early for a gimlet—if that is what you 
desire, the story continues.

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Indeed! That is precisely why I have come 
to the Arima Kinen. The God of Destruction 
shall trample this brilliant stage of 
dreams underfoot!

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
The hero standing to face the challenge is 
a passionate, free dancer. A traveler on 
the rugged path of heroes, holding aloft a 
shining resolve.

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
And now, my greatest trial. Come forth, 
countless protagonists! Strongest 
champions of your generation!

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Put your heart and soul on the line and 
try to trample me! The only ones allowed 
to trample others are those prepared to be 
trampled themselves!
